description: turbopack-core: compute_merged_modules' fixed point keeps one copy of each distinct bitmap and gives every module the id of its bitmap (BitmapInterner, with the union of two ids memoized), instead of a RoaringBitmap per module cloned from its importer. The traversal, its order and the union semantics are unchanged; the later grouping already compared bitmaps only for equality, through ids it computed by hashing every module's bitmap, which the interned ids now are. Test: interned ids are equal exactly when the bitmaps are, however each was built; the turbopack-tests snapshots (132, scope hoisting included) are unchanged
